content.comment_body: I need assistance connecting my [product_name] to my PC. When setting up the interface, I select Ethernet but only see the wireless Qualcomm card listed. Normally, Ethernet - Realtek Family PCIe should appear. I'm using [product_name] [version_no] on Windows 10. Reinstalling the software or updating Realtek Ethernet drivers did not solve the problem.
What is the IP address and subnet mask assigned to your PC?

This topic is closed as the question was posted twice. The other thread titled 'Can't connect [product_name] to PC' is available in the [product_name] - Communication section. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user is encountering issues connecting their [product_name] hardware to a PC using [product_name] [version_no] on Windows 10. The software only detects a wireless Qualcomm network card, not the expected Realtek Ethernet adaptor, preventing successful connection. Reinstalling the software and updating Ethernet drivers have not resolved the issue.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the software to correctly recognize the Ethernet interface, enabling connection between their PC and the [product_name] module for configuration and monitoring.
